message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Defendant Xu sold a house that he had already sold to someone else, concealed truth, signed a transfer agreement with victim for 55k, got 48k from victim, used to repay personal debt. This is fraud (诈骗). In Chinese criminal law, this is "诈骗罪". Also possibly "非法占有他人财产" but the specific offense is fraud. The act is selling a property he no longer owns, deceiving victim to obtain money. That's fraud. Also maybe "非法转让房屋所有权" but that's part of fraud. So charge: 诈骗.

Check if any other offenses: He returned 5k, victim forgave. No other crimes like "非法占有" separate? The law: Fraud (诈骗罪) covers obtaining property by deception. So only one charge.

Thus output: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>
